phoneNumber: Phone number must be an Iranian mobile number in the format 09XXXXXXXXX.
otp: OTP must be a six-digit numeric string.
nationalCode: National code must be a 10-digit numeric string.
firstName: First name must be at most 50 characters.
lastName: Last name must be at most 50 characters.
birthDate: Birth date must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
referralCode: Referral code must be at most 20 characters.
username: Username must be 3-30 characters, lowercase alphanumeric with . _ - only.

password.min: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password.max: Password must be at most 128 characters.
password.complexity: Password must contain at least one letter and one digit.

occupation: Occupation must be at most 100 characters.
